ai_content.intro: استمتع بمشاهدة مسلسل Rock, Paper, Scissors (2024) مترجم بجودة عالية على توميتو.
ai_content.desc_ar: استمتع بمشاهدة مسلسل حجر، ورقة، مقص مترجم بجودة عالية.
ai_content.desc_en: Rock, Paper, and Scissors are best friends and roommates who compete over everything, but it’s (mostly) all love. They each bring something different to the friendship - Rock is the moral compass, Paper is the practical one, and Scissors is the right amount of chaos. Together, they get into the wildest adventures.
